$schema_description: Nivesh Diagnostic Telemetry Contract — canonical schema for all error/diagnostic logging across the iOS client and FastAPI backend. Every exception intercepted by the app MUST produce a payload conforming to this contract. The payload is transmitted via POST /api/telemetry/diagnostic and persisted to PostgreSQL for operational visibility.

error_uuid.description: Generated client-side at the moment of exception interception. Used as the canonical key for deduplication and lookup.

correlation_id.description: Trace token prefixed with 'nivesh_ios_' that links the failing request to all upstream logs. Passed via the X-Correlation-ID HTTP header. Generated once per API call chain.

timestamp.description: Moment the exception was intercepted on the client or server. Always UTC, always includes the 'Z' suffix.

subsystem.description: Which logical section of the app produced the error.

classification.description: Error category used for routing, alert severity, and recovery strategy selection.

context.description: Runtime context at the moment of failure.

target_ticker.description: NSE/BSE ticker symbol the operation was targeting, if applicable.

market_hours_state.description: Whether the Indian market was live or closed at failure time.

active_data_provider.description: Which data source was being queried when the error occurred (NSE direct, Screener.in, YouTube, BSE, etc.).

telemetry.description: Request-level metadata for tracing the failing HTTP call end-to-end.

http_method.description: HTTP method of the failing request.

request_route.description: Backend route path that served the failing request.

ios_swift_file.description: The iOS Swift source file that initiated the network call (populated when the error surfaces on the client).

failing_node_contract.description: Human-readable label for the backend function or data-fetching node whose contract was violated, e.g. 'fetch_fundamentals: expected dict, got None'.

exception.description: Structured exception payload with app-level-only traceback.

type.description: Python exception class name or Swift error type.

message.description: Exception message string, truncated to 1024 characters.

items.description: A single stack frame in the format 'file_path:line_number in function_name'.

cleaned_traceback.description: Traceback frames filtered to ONLY app-level paths per traceback_cleaning_rules. Ordered from innermost (failing line) to outermost (caller).

automated_recovery_action.description: What the system automatically did to recover. Empty string if no action was taken.
automated_recovery_action.example: Fell back to cached response from 2026-06-05T14:30:00Z

classification.description: Valid error classifications and their meanings.

values.INFRASTRUCTURE_EXCEPTION: Database connection failure, Redis timeout, disk-full, or OS-level fault.
values.DOM_SCRAPE_SHIFT: Web scraper returned unexpected HTML structure (NSE/BSE/Screener.in changed their DOM).
values.SCHEMA_DRIFT: Response payload shape changed — missing keys, type mismatch, or unexpected nulls.
values.AGENT_PIPELINE_DROP: One of the LangChain/LangGraph trading agent nodes threw an unhandled exception or timed out.
values.AUTH_FAILURE: Token expired, invalid credentials, or unauthorized access to a protected resource.
values.RATE_LIMIT: Third-party API rate limit exceeded (NSE, BSE, Screener.in, YouTube, etc.).
values.DATA_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: Upstream data provider did not respond within the configured deadline.
values.CACHE_CORRUPTION: Cached response was malformed, stale beyond threshold, or failed deserialization.
values.VALIDATION_ERROR: Request payload failed Pydantic/FastAPI validation or business-rule validation.
values.UNKNOWN: Fallback classification when no other category matches.

market_hours_state.description: Indian market session states (NSE/BSE trading calendar).

values.LIVE_TRADING: Market is open — 09:15 to 15:30 IST, Monday through Friday.
values.CLOSED: Outside trading hours on a business day.
values.EXCHANGE_HOLIDAY: NSE/BSE declared holiday (e.g., Diwali, Republic Day).

subsystem.description: App sections that can produce telemetry.

values.MARKETS_DASHBOARD: Market overview, indices, sector performance, heatmaps.
values.EARNINGS_FEED: Quarterly results, earnings transcripts, conference call summaries.
values.PORTFOLIO: User holdings, watchlist, P&L tracking, portfolio snapshots.
values.ANALYSIS: Fundamental analysis, technical momentum, Piotroski scores, AI-driven analysis.
values.EXPERT_NETWORK: Expert opinions, consensus estimates, analyst ratings.
values.PREIPO_MARKETPLACE: Pre-IPO share discovery, grey market premium tracking.
values.ALERTS: Price alerts, news alerts, event-driven notifications.
values.TRADE_JOURNAL: Trade logging, performance review, strategy backtesting.
values.AUTH: Login, registration, token refresh, session management.
values.NEWS_MULTIMEDIA: News aggregation, YouTube finance harvesting, sentiment scoring.

traceback_cleaning_rules.description: Rules applied server-side before persisting exception.cleaned_traceback. Only frames whose file paths MATCH allowed prefixes survive. All other frames are stripped.
traceback_cleaning_rules.note: If after cleaning zero frames remain, the traceback is populated with a single entry: '<all frames were framework-level — no app code in traceback>'

ios_requirements.description: Requirements the iOS client MUST satisfy to ship compliant telemetry.

correlation_id_header.generation: Generated once per API call chain in NetworkManager.swift. Passed on every request including retries.
correlation_id_header.fallback: If the client fails to generate a correlation ID, the backend assigns one prefixed with 'nivesh_srv_' at middleware level.

console_mirror.description: Every telemetry payload posted to /api/telemetry/diagnostic MUST also be printed to the iOS console via os_log(.error) for local debugging.

diagnostic_drawer.description: The iOS app MUST provide a diagnostic drawer (accessible via Settings > Diagnostics or a long-press gesture on the app version label) that displays the last 20 telemetry events stored locally.
diagnostic_drawer.retention: In-memory ring buffer, cleared on app terminate.

visual_defensiveness.description: When ANY telemetry event fires, the affected UI component MUST degrade gracefully instead of showing a blank screen or crashing.
rules: Show a cached/stale-data banner with timestamp instead of an empty table view.
Present a toast with a retry button for transient failures (RATE_LIMIT, DATA_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT).
For SCHEMA_DRIFT, render only the fields that parsed successfully; missing fields show '—'.
For INFRASTRUCTURE_EXCEPTION, present a full-screen 'We'll be right back' placeholder with the correlation ID visible so support can trace it.

sql_schema.description: PostgreSQL DDL for persisting telemetry payloads. Designed for the Nivesh backend's existing PostgreSQL instance.
sql_schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_events (
    id              BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    error_uuid      UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    correlation_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
    timestamp       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    subsystem       TEXT NOT NULL,
    classification  TEXT NOT NULL,

    -- context
    target_ticker         TEXT,
    market_hours_state    TEXT NOT NULL,
    active_data_provider  TEXT,

    -- telemetry
    http_method           TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_route         TEXT NOT NULL,
    ios_swift_file        TEXT,
    failing_node_contract TEXT,

    -- exception
    exception_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
    exception_message TEXT NOT NULL,
    cleaned_traceback JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,

    -- recovery
    automated_recovery_action TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

    -- metadata
    payload_version  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.0.0',
    created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    -- constraints
    CONSTRAINT chk_subsystem CHECK (
        subsystem IN (
            'MARKETS_DASHBOARD', 'EARNINGS_FEED', 'PORTFOLIO', 'ANALYSIS',
            'EXPERT_NETWORK', 'PREIPO_MARKETPLACE', 'ALERTS', 'TRADE_JOURNAL',
            'AUTH', 'NEWS_MULTIMEDIA'
        )
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_classification CHECK (
        classification IN (
            'INFRASTRUCTURE_EXCEPTION', 'DOM_SCRAPE_SHIFT', 'SCHEMA_DRIFT',
            'AGENT_PIPELINE_DROP', 'AUTH_FAILURE', 'RATE_LIMIT',
            'DATA_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT', 'CACHE_CORRUPTION', 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
            'UNKNOWN'
        )
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_market_hours CHECK (
        market_hours_state IN (
            'LIVE_TRADING', 'PRE_MARKET', 'POST_MARKET', 'CLOSED', 'EXCHANGE_HOLIDAY'
        )
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_http_method CHECK (
        http_method IN ('GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'PATCH')
    )
);

-- Index for correlation_id lookups (support traces)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_telemetry_correlation_id
    ON telemetry_events (correlation_id);

-- Index for time-range queries (dashboard, alerting)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_telemetry_timestamp
    ON telemetry_events (timestamp DESC);

-- Composite index for subsystem + classification dashboards
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_telemetry_subsystem_class
    ON telemetry_events (subsystem, classification);

-- Index for ticker-specific debugging
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_telemetry_ticker
    ON telemetry_events (target_ticker)
    WHERE target_ticker IS NOT NULL;

-- Index for error_uuid deduplication lookups
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_telemetry_error_uuid
    ON telemetry_events (error_uuid);

api_endpoint.description: The backend route that accepts telemetry payloads.
api_endpoint.request_body: JSON payload conforming to payload_schema above.

response_400.detail: Validation error description referencing the specific field that failed.

response_429.detail: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after N seconds.
